mistech.configuration.title: Mistech Configs
item.mistech.runic_pipe.hint: Rune in the other hand + right-click to learn. Shift + mouse wheel switches.
guide.mistech.runic_pipe.1:
A pipe that learns runes like the §5Gnome Staff§r. Load it with dried leaves and light it like a regular Pipe.

Hold a §5rune§r in the other hand and right-click: the pipe learns the rune (each element once). §lShift + mouse wheel§r switches the chosen rune — the bowl glows in its color.
guide.mistech.runic_pipe.2:
With a rune chosen, each puff gives that rune's §5Magic Cigar§r (tobacco) or §5Magic Joint§r (hemp) effect for 1 min 30 s, plus affinity with the element.

With no rune chosen, it works like a regular pipe.
message.mistech.mist_form.no_room: No room to return to solid form
guide.mistech.pipe.1:
Load it with §5Dried Tobacco Leaf§r or §5Dried Hemp Leaf§r (one herb at a time, up to 16 leaves): leaf in the other hand + right-click (sneak to load the whole stack), or click the leaves onto the pipe in your inventory.

Light it like a cigar. It burns leaf by leaf, and each puff gives the §5cigar§r (tobacco) or §5joint§r (hemp) effects.
guide.mistech.pipe.2:
Sneak + right-click with an unlit pipe to take the leaves back (a leaf that already started burning is lost).

When the last leaf is gone the pipe goes out by itself and is empty, ready for another load.
guide.mistech.mist_pipe.1:
Needs no herb and no fire: right-click and, as you exhale, you §5become mist§r for 12 seconds.

As mist you fly, turn invisible, take no damage, and monsters forget you. You still bump into blocks, but you slip through any §5half-block§r gap.
guide.mistech.mist_pipe.2:
Mist cannot touch anything: no breaking, placing, opening, hitting or picking up items.

Use the pipe again to return early. If there is no room for your body, the mist lasts until you get out of the tight spot. 30 s cooldown. 32 uses.
guide.mistech.magma_rune.1:
Binds §5Fire§r and §5Earth§r. Aim and right-click:

§5Water§r turns into obsidian.
§5Obsidian§r turns into lava.
§5Stone§r turns into a magma block.
guide.mistech.vapor_rune.1: Binds §5Fire§r and §5Water§r. Releases a cloud of mist around you, 5 blocks wide in radius, lasting 20 seconds.
guide.mistech.void_rune.1:
Binds §5Space§r, §5Darkness§r and §5Earth§r. Erases the block you aim at, leaving nothing behind. Also erases water and lava sources.

Does not work on unbreakable blocks.
screen.mistech.astrology.hint: Drag to move • Mouse wheel to zoom • Click a star
screen.mistech.astrology.select: Explore the sky to find the constellations.
message.mistech.astrology_field_incomple: The Astrology Field is incomplete (check the block at %s, %s, %s)
message.mistech.astrology_field_broken: The Astrology Field under the table is incomplete
message.mistech.astrology_cannot_afford: You don't have enough XP or items
screen.mistech.natal.hint: Reveal in order, at the right time.
screen.mistech.natal.when.sun: Only by day, with the Sun in the sky
message.mistech.natal.wrong_time.sun: The Sun only reveals itself by day.
message.mistech.natal.wrong_time.moon: The Moon only reveals itself at night.
message.mistech.natal.wrong_time.rising: The Rising sign only reveals itself at dawn.
message.mistech.natal.rebirth: The stars realign... your birth chart is reborn, hidden once more.
guide.mistech.natal_chart.1:
When you arrived in the world, the stars secretly chose your §5Sun§r, your §5Moon§r and your §5Rising§r sign. They already act on you, but only at §5half§r strength while you do not know them.

At the Astrology Table, click §5✦ Birth Chart§r to reveal them, one at a time.
guide.mistech.natal_chart.2:
§5Sun§r: reveal by day (8 levels, 4 gold).
§5Moon§r: reveal at night (12 levels, 8 glowstone, Light Rune).
§5Rising§r: reveal at dawn, when the sign rises on the horizon (16 levels, Time Rune, 2 Shards).
guide.mistech.natal_chart.3:
Each sign grants part of its constellation's blessing: §5Sun§r 25% always, §5Moon§r 25% only at night, §5Rising§r 15% always.

The Sun also raises affinity with the sign's element by 50% and makes its constellation's stars 25% cheaper.

Fire: Aries, Leo, Sagittarius · Earth: Taurus, Virgo, Capricorn · Air: Gemini, Libra, Aquarius · Water: Cancer, Scorpio, Pisces.
guide.mistech.natal_chart.4:
With 1 paper you can copy the chart into a §5Birth Chart§r item, to keep or show your friends.

Only masters of the Tier III Altar can perform the §5Astral Rebirth§r: a new chart, rolled and hidden once more.
screen.mistech.astrology.pick_star: Click a star to see its cost.
guide.mistech.welcome.1:
This grimoire records the arts of §5Mistech§r: the old craft of incense, chalk and runes, bound to the new craft of energy and machines.

Each chapter is a map. Follow the lines: when you complete an entry, the next ones reveal themselves.

Scroll to zoom, drag to move the map. Inside an entry, the arrows turn pages and right-click goes back to the map.
guide.mistech.welcome.recipe: Lost your grimoire? Bind a book with an amethyst shard.
guide.mistech.path.1:
A suggested path through the arts:

§51.§r Craft §5Incense§r and burn it to gather §5Ash§r.
§52.§r Mix ash into §5Ash Chalk§r.
§53.§r Build a §5Writing Table§r and write your first §5Runes§r.
§54.§r Use runes to build §5Runic Machines§r and power them.
§55.§r Extract §5Magical Essence§r and compress it into shards.
§56.§r Raise an §5Astrology Field§r and read the stars.
guide.mistech.cat.basics.desc: Where magic meets machinery. Start here to learn how the Mistech arts fit together.
guide.mistech.incense.1:
Hold incense in one hand and a §5Flint and Steel§r (or a §5Fire Rune§r) in the other, then use it to light it.

Lit incense burns for §52 minutes§r, even in your inventory, and grants §5Incense Veil§r: zombies and skeletons will not see you as a target.

Sneak + use to put it out.
guide.mistech.incense_holder.1:
A small holder that burns incense on its own.

Put a lighter or Fire Rune in the first slot and up to 64 incense in the stock. It lights the next stick by itself and spreads the §5Incense Veil§r to every creature within §510 blocks§r.

Every finished stick leaves §5Incense Ash§r (35% chance of 2), even when burned in your hand. Only §5Magic Incense§r leaves §5Magic Residue§r instead.
guide.mistech.ash.1: Left behind by incense burned in an Incense Holder. Ash is the base of chalk and of many runic machines.
guide.mistech.ash.block: Ash Blocks fall like sand. Break one back into 4 ash in the crafting grid.
guide.mistech.ash_chalk.1: Chalk is how runes are drawn. It has §5100 uses§r and is spent at the §5Writing Table§r: §55§r per elemental rune and §510§r per Light, Darkness, Space or Time rune.
guide.mistech.cat.incense.desc: Smoke that hides you from the dead, and the ash it leaves behind.
guide.mistech.writing_table.recipe: The carpet color becomes the cloth color.
guide.mistech.writing_table.1:
Place §5Ash Chalk§r and §5Paper§r on the left, and up to four ingredients in the cross. The rune appears on the right.

Every rune costs §51 paper§r, the ingredients and some chalk durability. Items stay on the table when you leave.
guide.mistech.fire_rune.1: Works like a lighter: sets fire and lights incense, cigars and joints. Also powers the Runic Furnace.
guide.mistech.water_rune.1: Places a water source where you aim.
guide.mistech.earth_rune.1: Breaks the block you aim at, if a wooden pickaxe could mine it.
guide.mistech.air_rune.1: Throws a gust of wind (a Wind Charge).
guide.mistech.ice_rune.1: Freezes water into ice, ice into packed ice, packed into blue ice, and lava into obsidian.
guide.mistech.energy_rune.1: Calls a lightning bolt where you aim. The heart of every runic machine.
guide.mistech.light_rune.1: Grants Night Vision and Glowing for 90 seconds.
guide.mistech.darkness_rune.1: Releases a cloud of Blindness where you aim.
guide.mistech.space_rune.1: Teleports you to a random nearby spot, like a chorus fruit.
guide.mistech.time_rune.1: Speeds up time: acts as bone meal, grows amethyst buds and turns baby animals into adults.
guide.mistech.cat.runes.desc: Written with chalk on paper, runes hold a single spell. Each rune can be used 16 times.
guide.mistech.runic_furnace.1: A furnace that needs §5no fuel§r at all, and smelts §525% faster§r than a normal one. It keeps the experience of what it smelts.
guide.mistech.glass_jar.recipe: Holds one stack of a single item, shown inside.
guide.mistech.bottled_lightning.1: When lightning strikes within 2 blocks of an §5empty§r Glass Jar, the bolt is trapped inside. An Energy Rune is the easiest way to call one.
guide.mistech.condenser.1:
Uses energy (10 FE/t) and liquids touching it to make blocks every 10 seconds:

Water → Ice
Water + Ice → Packed Ice
Water + Packed → Blue Ice
Lava → Obsidian

The liquid is not used up.
guide.mistech.arcane_network.1:
Wireless energy. Attach an §5Arcane Node§r to a block that stores energy: it pulls from it and sends up to §51,000 FE/t§r to every §5Arcane Receiver§r within §510 blocks§r.

A Receiver delivers the energy into the block it is attached to, and listens to every Node in range.
guide.mistech.cat.machines.desc: Where runes become engines. These machines use or produce energy (FE) and work with other mods.
guide.mistech.essence_extractor.1:
An obsidian cauldron that fills with essence while powered: §51 level per minute§r, using 10 FE/t. Its cracks pulse like magma while it works.

Use a glass bottle to take one level, or a bucket when it is full.
guide.mistech.impure_essence.1: A dark, almost black liquid that swims like water. Touching it makes you §5levitate§r for a few seconds, so be careful where you pour it.
guide.mistech.impure_essence.2: Bottled essence stacks up to 16 and is used by the Magic Compressor.
guide.mistech.magic_compressor.1: Pour a bottle of essence into the hole on top. It hardens in §515 seconds§r, but only while §5lit incense§r is nearby: carried by a player within 6 blocks, or burning in an Incense Holder whose area reaches it.
guide.mistech.magic_compressor.2: The result is an §5Impure Magic Shard§r, a tiny black hole of solid magic used in advanced crafting.
guide.mistech.cat.essence.desc: Raw magic, drawn out of the world by force and hardened into matter.
guide.mistech.crops.1:
§5Tobacco§r, §5Hemp§r and §5Belladonna§r seeds can drop when you break grass. Plant them on farmland; they grow like wheat.

Ripe hemp gives leaves, fiber and seeds.
guide.mistech.crops.dry: Dry leaves in a furnace, smoker, campfire or Runic Furnace.
guide.mistech.cigar.1: Light it like incense, then hold use to take a puff. Each puff §5clears negative effects§r and grants §5Tobacco Focus§r, which narrows your field of view.
guide.mistech.joint.1: Light it like incense and hold use to take a puff. Your vision gets hazy (§5Nausea§r) and you get §5Hungry§r.
guide.mistech.runic_ashtray.1: Use it while holding incense, a cigar or a joint to light it, or to put it out if it is already lit.
guide.mistech.cat.herbalism.desc: Plants of focus and of haze. Grown on farmland, dried and rolled.
guide.mistech.guide_stone.recipe: The dye sets the stone's color.
guide.mistech.guide_stone.1: A jewel of emerald and amethyst. It is the §5key§r of rituals and multiblocks: it is never used up.
guide.mistech.astrology_field.legend: Lapis and gold blocks. Empty cells can be anything.
guide.mistech.astrology_field.1:
Build this 7×7 base and place a §5Writing Table§r on the center gold block.

Then use the §5Guide Stone§r on the table: it becomes an §5Astrology Table§r. If a block is missing, the stone shows you where.
guide.mistech.astrology_table.1: Opens a map of the night sky, as long as the field below is complete. Drag to look around and scroll to zoom.
guide.mistech.astrology_table.2: The twelve zodiac constellations are hidden somewhere in the sky. §5Search for them§r: once you unlock a constellation's first star, it appears in the list and you can jump to it.
guide.mistech.constellations.1:
Each constellation keeps its real stars and shape. Stars are unlocked in order, starting from the brightest and following the lines.

A star costs §5experience levels§r and, later, §5items§r tied to its constellation. Every unlocked star grants a small permanent blessing; complete the constellation for its full power.
guide.mistech.constellations.2:
Blessings are yours alone and are kept even when you die.

§5Aries§r strength · §5Taurus§r health · §5Gemini§r speed · §5Cancer§r armor · §5Leo§r attack speed · §5Virgo§r luck · §5Libra§r steadiness · §5Scorpius§r toughness · §5Sagittarius§r reach · §5Capricornus§r mining · §5Aquarius§r breath · §5Pisces§r swimming
guide.mistech.cat.astrology.desc: The stars remember what the world forgot. Build an altar and learn from them.
guide.mistech.title: Mistech Grimoire
guide.mistech.subtitle: Of Smoke, Chalk and Stars
guide.mistech.intro:
Magic and machinery were never enemies. They only lacked a common language.

This book is that language.
guide.mistech.magic_incense.recipe: The tip is an §5Impure Magic Shard§r instead of a flower.
guide.mistech.magic_incense.1:
Works like regular incense, but burns for §58 minutes§r and reaches §54× farther§r: §540 blocks§r in the Incense Holder, and pursuers within §5128 blocks§r lose track of you.

Every §530 seconds§r of burning it leaves §5Magic Residue§r (16 per stick): in your inventory, or in the holder's ash slot.
guide.mistech.magic_residue.1: A black, faintly glowing ash left by §5Magic Incense§r. Used to make §5Impure Chalk§r.
guide.mistech.impure_chalk.1: A darker chalk made with §5Magic Residue§r. It works in the §5Writing Table§r just like Ash Chalk, but has §5800 uses§r instead of 100.
message.mistech.confector_incomplete: A Runic Tank is missing at %s, %s, %s
gui.mistech.confector.empty: Nothing to write with what is stored.
gui.mistech.confector.hint_make: Click: write 1 · Shift: write until out
gui.mistech.confector.power_hint: When on, each redstone pulse writes 1 of the selected rune.
gui.mistech.confector.tank_hint: Put a full bottle or bucket in the slot below
guide.mistech.cat.automation.desc: Store a lot, carry it all, and let the runes write themselves.
guide.mistech.spatial_barrel.1:
A barrel folded into space: it holds §5162 stacks§r, as much as three double chests.

When broken, §5the items stay inside it§r, like a shulker box. That is why a Spatial Barrel (or backpack, or shulker) can't go inside another.

Hoppers and pipes work on any side.
guide.mistech.runic_tank.1:
Holds up to §5100 buckets§r of a single liquid: water, lava, §5Impure Magic Essence§r...

Use buckets, water bottles or essence flasks to fill and empty it. Pipes from other mods work too.

When broken, the liquid stays in the item.
guide.mistech.carryable_barrel.recipe: The barrel's items stay inside the backpack.
guide.mistech.carryable_barrel.1:
A Spatial Barrel with straps: the same §5162 slots§r, now on your back.

§5Sneak + use§r to wear it in the chestplate slot. Press §5B§r to open it (worn or anywhere in your inventory), or use it while holding it.
guide.mistech.rune_confector.base: Front view: a Spatial Barrel next to a Writing Table (either side), with a Runic Tank on top of each.
guide.mistech.rune_confector.1:
Build the four pieces and use the §5Guide Stone§r on the Writing Table. They become a single block: an automatic Writing Table.

Whatever was on the table and the first §527§r items of the barrel go inside; the rest drops on the ground. The tanks' liquid is kept too.
guide.mistech.rune_confector.2:
§5Left§r: ingredients and the two tanks. Water bottles, buckets and essence flasks in recipes are taken straight from the tanks.

§5Middle§r: the runes you can write. Click to select, click again to write (Shift writes until out).

§5Right§r: chalk and output.
guide.mistech.rune_confector.3:
The §5power button§r in the corner turns on automatic mode: with a rune selected, §5each redstone pulse§r writes one.

Hoppers on top and sides insert ingredients (and chalk); finished runes come out the bottom.

Breaking any part takes it apart and gives the pieces back.
guide.mistech.magic_smoke.4:
§5Advanced runes§r (affinity goes to the elements that form them)
Magma: fire resist. + resistance / burning hits + strength + haste II
Vapor: fire resist. + water breathing + slow falling / speed II + jump II + dolphin
Void: 25% dodge + resistance / +3 reach + blinding hits + haste
guide.mistech.gnome_staff.4:
§5Advanced runes§r
§cMagma§r: an eruption at the target — burns and launches creatures; nearby stone turns to magma.
§7Vapor§r: a steam burst around you — scalds, blinds and pushes creatures, leaving mist behind.
§5Void§r: opens a rift for 5 s that pulls creatures in and hurts those that reach the center.
gui.mistech.roller.missing: Missing rune, leaf, residue or output space
gui.mistech.roller.power_hint: When on, rolls 1 of the selected option every 2 seconds while there is material.
guide.mistech.magic_smoke.recipe: Dried tobacco = cigar; dried hemp = joint. The rune loses 1 use and comes back.
guide.mistech.magic_smoke.1:
Instead of paper, the leaf is rolled in a §5rune§r and seasoned with §5Magic Residue§r. Each rune makes §516§r, one per use.

The §5cigar§r (tobacco) grants a §5defense§r of the element; the §5joint§r (hemp) grants a §5power§r of the element. Each puff gives the effect for §51 min 30 s§r.
guide.mistech.magic_smoke.2:
§5Cigar§r / §5Joint§r
Fire: fire resist. / strength + hits burn
Water: water breathing / dolphin + conduit
Earth: resistance / haste II
Air: slow falling / speed II + jump II
Ice: no freezing, attackers slowed / hits freeze
guide.mistech.magic_smoke.3:
Energy: absorption II / haste + strength
Light: health boost II / night vision + luck
Darkness: invisibility / hits blind and weaken
Space: 25% teleport dodge / +3 reach
Time: regeneration / speed + haste II
guide.mistech.rune_roller.1:
Makes magic cigars and joints on its own.

§5Left§r: up to 4 runes, dried tobacco, dried hemp and Magic Residue. §5Middle§r: the 20 options; click to select, again to roll (Shift rolls until out).

The §5power button§r makes it roll 1 every 2 seconds. Hoppers insert material from the top and sides and pull finished ones from the bottom.
guide.mistech.coffee.1:
§5Coffee Seeds§r drop from grass, like the other plants. Plant them on farmland; when mature, the plant gives §5Coffee Cherries§r.

In a crafting table each cherry becomes §53 seeds§r. Roast the seeds in a furnace, smoker, campfire or Runic Furnace to get §5Roasted Beans§r.
guide.mistech.coffee.grinder: A stick on top of a cobblestone slab.
guide.mistech.coffee.2:
Hold the §5Grinder§r in one hand and roasted beans in the other and use it: each use grinds 1 bean into §5Coffee Powder§r.

In the §5Kettle§r, §5water + Coffee Powder§r, taken with a Cup = §5Cup of Coffee§r: Haste and Speed for 1:30.
guide.mistech.mystic_sight.1:
In the §5Kettle§r, §5water + Belladonna Berries§r, taken with a Cup, make §5Belladonna Tea§r.

For 1:30 your field of view widens, colors shift and the world seems to sway. They say this is how you see what is hidden...
guide.mistech.cat.wear.desc: Wool clothes for young mystics. Little protection, lots of help.
guide.mistech.gnome_hat.1:
A huge hat that droops backwards.

§5+1 luck§r, §5+10% speed§r and you become §510% smaller§r.
guide.mistech.mystic_robe.1:
A robe open in the front that reaches down to the legs.

§5Gravity is 30% lower§r (jump higher, fall slower) and §5cold hurts half§r.
guide.mistech.comfy_pants.1:
Magically comfortable pajama pants.

§5Projectiles hurt 30% less§r, §5fall damage is halved§r and you can fall §51 extra block§r safely.
guide.mistech.slippers.1:
Fluffy slippers.

You §5step up 1 block without jumping§r and §5walk on powder snow§r, like leather boots.
guide.mistech.wear.dye: All of them are made of wool, have low defense and can be dyed in a crafting table, like leather armor.
guide.mistech.murky_tree.1: Under §5Mystic Sight§r (Belladonna Tea), the veil over the forest thins. Break the leaves of any tree while the effect lasts - or let them fall after cutting the trunk nearby - and every sapling that drops becomes a §8Murky Tree Sapling§r.
guide.mistech.murky_tree.2:
The Murky Tree has §lno leaves§r: only a black trunk and branches spread like a cherry tree's, veined with gold. Since it never drops saplings, the only other way to get more is growing one in a §6Botany Pot§r.

Its wood makes everything common wood does: planks, stairs, doors, signs, boats...
guide.mistech.impure_magic_block.1:
A dense block of §5Impure Magic Shards§r bound with §8Magic Residue§r. Its veins pulse slowly between §5purple§r and §6orange§r, and it glows faintly in the dark.

It can be used as a beacon base, and will be needed for the more advanced rituals.
guide.mistech.gnomes.1: When a §8Murky Tree§r grows, there is a small chance (10%) that a §eYellowish Mushroom§r sprouts beside it. Gnomes can't resist its smell.
guide.mistech.gnomes.2: §lBurning it:§r right-click a lit campfire with the Gnome Bait. After a few seconds a §cGnome§r shows up. He is peaceful until attacked - and hits hard with his staff. Defeat him to get the §5Gnome Staff§r and his §cred Gnome Hat§r.
guide.mistech.gnomes.3: §lTrapping:§r put Gnome Bait inside a §fGlass Jar§r. Every few seconds there is a chance a gnome sneaks in to eat it and gets stuck: the jar becomes a §6Bottled Gnome§r (1 bait is used, the rest pops out).
item.mistech.gnome_staff.hint: Rune in the other hand + right-click to add it. Shift + scroll to switch.
item.mistech.gnome_staff.already: The staff already has the %s rune
item.mistech.gnome_staff.no_energy: The staff is out of energy
item.mistech.gnome_staff.needs_water: This spell needs water or rain
guide.mistech.gnome_staff.1:
The §5Gnome Staff§r has a battery (50,000 FE): charge it in any energy charger, like the §6Gnome Bicycle§r battery slot.

Hold a §5rune§r in the other hand and right-click: the staff absorbs it. Each element fits once. §lShift + mouse wheel§r switches the rune - the orb takes its color. The default mode does nothing.
guide.mistech.gnome_staff.2:
Hold right-click to cast. §6Fire§r and §2Time§r keep going while you hold; the others charge for half a second and fire when you let go.

§6Fire§r: breath of fire.
§9Water§r: riptide (in water or rain).
§fAir§r: big leap, no fall damage.
§6Earth§r: 3x3 tunnel (up to iron hardness).
§eEnergy§r: a storm of lightning.
guide.mistech.gnome_staff.3:
§bIce§r: freezes creatures around you and turns water into ice.
§eLight§r: a burst of light that hurts creatures (undead take more).
§5Darkness§r: a zone that holds creatures in place and withers them.
§dSpace§r: teleport up to 16 blocks forward.
§2Time§r: the targeted block ticks much faster (crops, furnaces...).
message.mistech.astral_pillar_needs_lapi: A Block of Lapis Lazuli must be under the Impure Magic Block
message.mistech.astral_pillar_needs_murk: A Murky Log must be under the Lapis Lazuli
guide.mistech.astral_pillar.1:
Stack a §8Murky Log§r, a §9Block of Lapis Lazuli§r and a §5Block of Impure Magic§r, then right-click the top with the §dGuide Stone§r. The three blocks merge into a pillar that narrows to a glowing tip.

It can be broken and carried like any block.
guide.mistech.astral_pillar.2:
Place pillars on the four §6gold blocks§r at the cardinal points of the §9Astrology Field§r (two blocks from the table). Each pillar raises every astrology bonus by §d12.5%§r - up to §d+50%§r with all four.

The connection is updated whenever you use the table.
message.mistech.bottled_gnome.hungry: The gnome is hungry... give it an apple
message.mistech.golem_wand.source: Source set at %s. Now click the destination.
message.mistech.golem_wand.target: Destination set at %s. Click a golem to give it the route.
message.mistech.golem_wand.too_far: Too far! Source and destination must be within %s blocks.
message.mistech.golem_wand.incomplete: Mark the source and the destination with the wand first.
message.mistech.clay_golem.no_route: No route (filter: %s). Use the Command Wand.
tooltip.mistech.accessory.ember_ring: Puts out fire on you; -50%% fire damage
tooltip.mistech.accessory.breeze_ring: No fall damage up to 12 blocks; higher jumps
tooltip.mistech.accessory.constellation_: Doubles the bonus of the engraved constellation
tooltip.mistech.constellation_amulet.unb: Not engraved: click an Astrology Table
message.mistech.constellation_amulet.non: Complete a constellation at the Astrology Table first
message.mistech.familiar.tamed: The gnome is now your familiar!
guide.mistech.runic_crusher.1:
Two grindstones that grind whatever falls in the funnel. Uses §b20 FE/t§r and takes §e5 s§r per item.

§6Ore§r becomes §62 dusts§r (sometimes 3). §6Raw ore§r becomes 1 dust (sometimes 2). Dusts smelt into ingots.
guide.mistech.runic_crusher.2:
With an §aEarth Rune§r in the rune slot, every ore gives §a+1§r. The rune loses 1 use every 8 ores.

It also grinds cobblestone, gravel, wool, bones, blaze rods and flowers.

Hoppers on top and sides, output below.
guide.mistech.ash_generator.1:
Burns what is left of the incense and releases the magic trapped in the ashes.

§7Ashes§r: 4,000 FE (40 FE/t)
§7Ash Block§r: 18,000 FE (40 FE/t)
§5Magic Residue§r: 12,000 FE (60 FE/t)

Sends power to touching blocks.
guide.mistech.astral_generator.1:
Makes power from starlight: only §9at night§r and with §9open sky§r above.

Without the moon in the way more stars show: §9new moon 40 FE/t§r, crescent 30, quarter 25, gibbous 20 and §7full moon 15§r. Rain cuts it to 25%.

A complete §9Astrology Table§r within 16 blocks gives §d+25%§r.
guide.mistech.farming_machines.1:
The §6Harvester§r picks ripe plants in a §e9×9 area in front§r of it (200 FE per plant) and stores them in 9 slots. It harvests crops, wart, cocoa, berries, pumpkins, melons, sugar cane, bamboo and cactus.

§dSpace Rune§r: 13×13 area.
guide.mistech.farming_machines.2:
The §6Planter§r plants the seeds from its 9 slots in the same area and tills the soil when needed (100 FE per plant).

§bWater Rune§r: keeps farmland wet.
§eTime Rune§r: bone meal on a plant every 5 s.

Point both at the same field.
guide.mistech.gnome_boost.1: A well fed §eBottled Gnome§r works for you: Mistech machines within §e3 blocks§r run §a50% faster§r.
guide.mistech.gnome_boost.2:
Give the gnome §capples§r: each is worth 5 minutes (golden apple: 30 min, up to 1 hour stored). A hopper can feed the jar too.

When hungry it stops and smokes. Several gnomes do not stack.

Works on: Runic Furnace, Condenser, Extractor, Compressor, Crusher, Harvester and Planter.
guide.mistech.cat.machines2.desc: Crush ores, make power from ashes and starlight and let the farm run itself.
guide.mistech.clay_golem.1:
Place the §7Clay Statue§r and click it with a §eTime Rune§r: it comes to life.

The §7Clay Golem§r carries up to §e16 items§r per trip from one chest (or machine) to another, nonstop.
guide.mistech.clay_golem.2:
With the §dCommand Wand§r: click the §asource§r, then the §6destination§r (up to 24 blocks) and finally the golem.

Click the golem with an item so it carries §eonly that item§r; sneak with an empty hand to clear the filter. Sneak with the wand to see the route.

Smoke = waiting; anger = cannot find a path.
guide.mistech.familiars.1:
Give a gnome a §6Golden Apple§r: with luck (1 in 3) it becomes your §efamiliar§r. Up to 3 per player.

It follows you and teleports when far away. §7Sneak + empty hand§r: it stays and works within 8 blocks of that spot (or follows again).
guide.mistech.familiars.2:
Familiars eat §capples§r (click with apples, stores up to 16; each = 5 min of work). Hungry ones get lazy and only follow.

The item you give sets the job (empty hand takes it back):
§7nothing§r Companion: Luck
§7hoe§r Gardener: harvests and replants
§7chest§r Collector: puts loose items in the nearest chest
guide.mistech.familiars.3:
§7sword§r Guard: attacks monsters near you
§7Gnome Staff§r Mage: casts the spell of the rune selected on the staff (fire, lightning, ice, light...) using the staff's energy.
guide.mistech.cat.golems.desc: Clay helpers and friendly gnomes that work by your side.
guide.mistech.accessory_bases.1:
Press §eJ§r to open your accessories: §61 amulet§r and §62 rings§r. They stay with you when you die.

The bases are engraved at the §dWriting Table§r together with a rune. Identical effects do not stack.
guide.mistech.rings.ember: Puts out fire on you and halves fire damage.
guide.mistech.rings.breeze: No fall damage up to 12 blocks and higher jumps.
guide.mistech.rings.frost: Still water freezes under your feet.
guide.mistech.amulets.constellation: Click an Astrology Table to engrave a §ecomplete§r constellation (click again to switch). Doubles its bonus.
guide.mistech.amulets.gnome: +1 familiar. Nearby familiars heal 1 heart every 10 s.
guide.mistech.amulets.essence: Gnome Staff spells use 25% less energy.
guide.mistech.cat.accessories.desc: Rings and amulets engraved with runes. Press J to equip.
ritual.mistech.condition.full_moon: Only on a full moon night
message.mistech.ritual.no_catalyst: Place the catalyst on the altar.
message.mistech.ritual.essence: Not enough essence: needs %s, basin has %s.
message.mistech.ritual.started: The ritual has begun. Do not break the circle!
message.mistech.ritual.backlash: Impure Backlash! The circle was broken.
message.mistech.ritual.no_player: Whoever started the ritual must be nearby.
message.mistech.ritual.structure.incense: The Incense Holder at %s %s %s needs lit Magic Incense
message.mistech.black_cat.saved: Your Black Cat spent a life to save you! (%s left)
guide.mistech.cat.rituals.desc: Impure magic, circles of chalk and the Impure Altar.
guide.mistech.impure_altar.recipe: The heart of every Tier I ritual.
guide.mistech.impure_altar.1:
The altar holds up to §58 levels§r of Impure Essence: an Essence Flask adds 1, a bucket adds 3, and an empty bottle takes 1 back.

Right-click with any other item to place the §5catalyst§r; empty hand takes it (or the ritual result) back.
guide.mistech.ritual_circle.legend: A altar · P pedestal · I Incense Holder · G Chalk Mark (drawn with Ash Chalk).
guide.mistech.ritual_circle.1:
Draw the §5Chalk Marks§r by right-clicking the top of a block with §5Ash Chalk§r (1 use each).

The four §5Incense Holders§r must burn §5Magic Incense§r during the whole ritual.

Put the ingredients on the §5Ritual Pedestals§r and use the §5Guide Stone§r on the altar.
guide.mistech.ritual_circle.2:
If the circle breaks mid-ritual — an incense burns out, a block is removed — comes the §4Impure Backlash§r: the items are lost, essence spills and everyone nearby withers.

A §5Ritual Dagger§r (sneak + right-click the altar) closes a ritual safely.
guide.mistech.owl.1: §5Owl§r: at night, hostile mobs nearby glow — only for you. It hoots when something targets you and gives Night Vision in the dark. Feed it raw rabbit or chicken (10 min each).
guide.mistech.black_cat.1: §5Black Cat§r: +1 Luck, scares creepers and phantoms, leaves a gift every midnight. §5Seven Lives§r: saves you from death up to 7 times. Feed it raw cod or salmon.
guide.mistech.sunrise.1: Skips to the next sunrise (Light Rune).
guide.mistech.nightfall.1: Skips to the next nightfall (Darkness Rune).
guide.mistech.harvest_blessing.1: Within 12 blocks: crops ripen, saplings grow and animals fall in love.
guide.mistech.protection_seal.1: For 3 days, hostile mobs do not spawn within 48 blocks of the altar.
guide.mistech.impure_tools.1: Tools reforged in the circle keep their enchantments. 1800 uses, repaired with Impure Magic Shards.
guide.mistech.ritual_dagger.1: Withers what it hits; 25% chance of Magic Residue on kills; safely closes rituals.
guide.mistech.impure_pickaxe.1: Everything it mines comes out already smelted.
guide.mistech.impure_axe.1: Fells the whole tree (up to 64 logs). Sneak to cut a single log.
guide.mistech.impure_hoe.1: Tills 3×3. On a ripe crop: harvests and replants.
guide.mistech.impure_heart.1: Only under a full moon. The key to the Tier II altar.
message.mistech.ritual.altar_tier: This spell needs an altar of Tier %s.
message.mistech.ritual.wrong_altar_tier: This ritual only works on a Tier %s altar.
message.mistech.ritual.ascended: The altar ascended to Tier %s! Complete the new circle around it.
guide.mistech.altar_tier2.1:
The altar is not crafted at Tier II: it has to §5ascend§r. First awaken the Heart (thunderstorm), then place the §5Awakened Heart§r on a Tier I altar and wait for the full moon.

§cBefore you start§r, the 4 §bMithril Obelisks§r must already stand on the diagonals 4 blocks from the altar.
guide.mistech.altar_tier2.legend: 3×3 chalk, Impure Chalk (X) at 2, 8 pedestals, Obelisks (O) at the corners.
guide.mistech.altar_tier2.2:
§5Tier II circle§r (9×9):
• Chalk Marks around the altar (3×3).
• §5Impure Chalk Marks§r 2 blocks out in the 4 directions.
• 4 pedestals 3 blocks out plus 4 on the (2,2) diagonals.
• Incense holders at the (3,3) corners, lit with Magic Incense.
• §b4 Mithril Obelisks§r on the (4,4) diagonals.

Tier II rituals use up to 8 pedestals.
guide.mistech.altar_tier3.1:
With the §5Astral Heart§r as catalyst, the Awakened Heart on the pedestals and the elevated runes, a Tier II altar ascends again under the full moon.

§cBefore§r: the 4 §5Astral Pillars§r and the 4 §6lit Orichalcum Braziers§r must already be in place.
guide.mistech.altar_tier3.2:
§5Tier III circle§r (11×11): the whole Tier II circle (with the Obelisks) plus 4 §5Astral Pillars§r 4 blocks out in the 4 directions and 4 §6lit Orichalcum Braziers§r 5 blocks out, behind the pillars.

If a brazier goes out mid-ritual, the circle breaks — beware of thunderstorms.
message.mistech.ritual.already_full_moon: The full moon is already in the sky.
guide.mistech.full_moon.1: Performed at night, it pulls the sky forward to the night of the next full moon (up to 8 days pass at once). Use it before rituals that demand the full moon, like the Heart and the Altar Ascension.
message.mistech.gnome_bicycle.mounted: The gnome hopped on the bicycle! Give it apples so it pedals
guide.mistech.gnome_bicycle.1:
Click the bicycle with a §6Bottled Gnome§r: the gnome leaves the jar (you get the empty jar back) and hops on.

With food it pedals and makes §520 FE/t§r. Stores 20,000 FE and pushes up to 200 FE/t into machines on any side.
guide.mistech.gnome_bicycle.2:
Put §capples§r in the food slot (a hopper works too): each apple is 1 minute of pedaling, a golden apple 10 minutes. When the buffer is full the gnome rests and doesn't eat.

The battery slot charges items with energy, like the Gnome Staff. To take the gnome back, click with an empty Glass Jar; breaking the bicycle drops the Bottled Gnome.
guide.mistech.kettle.1:
The Fire Rune in the recipe keeps the §5Kettle§r hot on its own: no brewing stand, no blaze powder.

§51.§r Water bucket (6 cups) or water bottles (2 each).
§52.§r One §5Coffee Powder§r or §5Belladonna Berries§r.
§53.§r Wait about 5 seconds and take it with §5Cups§r, 1 per serving.
message.mistech.kettle.empty: The kettle is empty. Add water
message.mistech.kettle.water: Water: %s/6 cups. Add Coffee Powder or Belladonna Berries
message.mistech.kettle.ready: Ready: %s cup(s) of %s. Take it with Cups
guide.mistech.cup.recipe: 3 clay balls in a bowl shape. Fire the Raw Cup in a furnace.
message.mistech.sleep_paralysis.start: You wake up... but you can't move. Someone is sitting on your chest.
message.mistech.sleep_paralysis.end: The weight is gone. The Pisadeira left... for now.
message.mistech.gnome_realm.dream: The Dreamcatcher holds the nightmare back. You dream of giggles and red hats... (the Gnome Realm is still being built)
guide.mistech.dreams.1: In the §5Kettle§r, §5water + Yellowish Mushroom§r, taken with a Cup, makes §5Mushroom Tea§r: §6Psychedelic Sight§r for 1:30. Like Mystic Sight, only much stronger - colors swirl and the world ripples.
guide.mistech.dreams.2:
§lCareful sleeping under the effect.§r When you wake up you are paralyzed in bed and the §cPisadeira§r sits on your chest for a few seconds.

With a §5Dreamcatcher§r within 6 blocks of the bed the nightmare doesn't come: the dream takes you to the §2Gnome Realm§r.
guide.mistech.dreamcatcher.recipe: Stick, string and Magic Residue. Hang it on a wall.
message.mistech.gnome_realm.enter: You wake up in a dream... giggles everywhere. Welcome to the Gnome Realm.
message.mistech.gnome_realm.wake: You wake up in your bed. Was it just a dream?
message.mistech.gnome_realm.died: The dream turns into a nightmare... and you wake up.
message.mistech.gnome_king.farewell: Gnome King: "Leaving already? Then close your eyes... and wake up!"
guide.mistech.gnome_realm.1:
Sleep under §6Psychedelic Sight§r with a §5Dreamcatcher§r near the bed and you dream of the §2Gnome Realm§r.

At the center there is a green meadow with huge trees and the §6King's House§r, full of gnomes. A spiral staircase leads down to their mine, with tunnels full of ore.
guide.mistech.gnome_realm.2:
The §6Gnome King§r trades important items (click him). Sneak + click and he sends you back home.

Other ways out: §5sleep§r in a bed there or §cdie§r - dying in the dream just wakes you up in your bed, losing nothing.
guide.mistech.gnome_realm.3:
The dream has §5layers§r, one around the other — and they are far apart:
• §2Common Dream§r (up to ~400 blocks): Meadow, §dSweet Mushroom Grove§r and §fPillow Hills§r.
• §8Nightmare§r (up to ~2000): Murky Wastes, §8Forest of Hands§r, §8Falling Chasms§r and the rare §8Wrong Neighborhood§r. Stay there too long and you start to feel §cwatched§r.
message.mistech.miner_incomplete: A Miner part is missing at %s, %s, %s
gui.mistech.miner.filter.help: Click with an item to mark it; empty hand clears. Matches are destroyed.
gui.mistech.miner.filter.off: Needs a Void Rune to work.
guide.mistech.tunneler.1:
A drill powered by an §aEarth Rune§r. On each §credstone pulse§r it breaks the block in front like an §firon pickaxe§r, using §b400 FE§r.

The drill points where you were looking when you placed it. What it breaks goes into the chest or barrel §ebehind§r it; with no container, it drops on the ground.

It won't break chests, machines or blocks an iron pickaxe can't harvest. Click it to see its energy.
guide.mistech.miner.base: §6Base:§r a Spatial Barrel in the middle and a Tunneler on each side (facing any direction). Corners are free.
guide.mistech.miner.top: §6On top:§r a Block of Impure Magic over the barrel. Click it with the §dGuide Stone§r to awaken the Miner. Once awakened the parts lock together: the Tunnelers become §7drilling legs§r with arms reaching the core, and the barrel becomes the §5Collection Chamber§r (it still stores everything — click it to open). Clicking a leg opens the Miner. To grab items from above, §esneak-click the core§r (or use the button on its screen); hoppers and pipes on the core also pull from and insert into the chamber.
guide.mistech.miner.1:
While it has energy, the Miner breaks its chunk §eblock by block§r, layer by layer, from the base down to the bottom of the world. Everything goes into the middle §5Spatial Barrel§r; full barrel = pause.

Without runes: §e2 blocks/s§r, §b100 FE§r per block. Power goes into the core.
guide.mistech.miner.2:
It has §d4 rune slots§r (repeated runes add levels):
§cFire§r: smelts drops.
§aEarth§r: ore becomes dust (with Fire, ingots).
§5Space§r: area 1×1 → 3×3 → 5×5 → 7×7 → 9×9 chunks.
§eTime§r: 2 → 4 → 10 → 20 → 40 blocks/s.
§bEnergy§r: -20 FE per block each.
§8Void§r: enables the trash filter.
guide.mistech.miner.3:
§8Trash filter§r: with a Void Rune, click the 9 slots with an item to mark it (the item isn't used up). Anything matching the filter is destroyed instead of going to the barrel.

It won't break chests, spawners or machines. If a part is removed the Miner stops, and resumes on its own once it's back. Breaking the core returns the Block of Impure Magic.
guide.mistech.realm_ores.1:
The §8Gnome Depths§r reach all the way to the bottom of the world, through §8deepslate§r just like the Overworld. Down there are three metals only gnomes know about.

From least to most rare: §bMithril§r, §cAdamantine§r and §6Orichalcum§r.
guide.mistech.realm_ores.2:
§bMithril§r: stone and deepslate, below y 16 (most common near y -24). Rarer than diamond. Needs an §firon§r pickaxe.

Smelts in a furnace or blast furnace.
guide.mistech.realm_ores.3:
§cAdamantine§r: deepslate only, from y -8 down. As rare as netherite and never exposed to air - dig into the walls. Needs a §bdiamond§r pickaxe.

Only smelts in a §7blast furnace§r.
guide.mistech.realm_ores.4:
§6Orichalcum§r: at the very bottom, from y -36 down, always hidden inside the rock. Glows faintly. Rarer than netherite. Needs a §5netherite§r pickaxe.

Only smelts in a §7blast furnace§r and doesn't burn in lava.
guide.mistech.runic_battery.1:
A copper cylinder with a §eBottled Lightning§r trapped inside. Stores up to §6200,000 FE§r.

Receives energy on §levery face except the front§r and outputs through the §lfront§r (the side with the little window), up to 1,000 FE/t. This way batteries can be chained without energy bouncing back and forth.
guide.mistech.runic_battery.2:
The window lights up while energy is stored. The slot in its screen charges items that hold energy, like the §5Gnome Staff§r.

When broken, the battery §lkeeps its energy§r in the item (shown on the bar and tooltip). A comparator reads how full it is.
guide.mistech.advanced_runic_battery.1:
Four batteries bound by §5Impure Magic§r around a §8Void Rune§r. Stores §61,000,000 FE§r and §lneeds no wires§r:

§7•§r §edrains§r energy from generators up to §l3 blocks§r away
§7•§r §bpowers§r machines up to §l5 blocks§r away

Up to 1,000 FE/t per generator and per machine.
guide.mistech.advanced_runic_battery.2:
Distance counts in every direction (a cube around the battery). The area is rechecked every 2 seconds; the screen shows how many generators and machines are linked.

It also receives and outputs on any face and ignores other Runic Batteries, so energy doesn't loop around.
message.mistech.miner_no_chamber: The Miner isn't assembled: the Collection Chamber is unavailable.
gui.mistech.miner.open_chamber.help: Or sneak and click the core with an empty hand.
message.mistech.bone_lock.hint: The lock has holes for Bone Keys. %s missing.
message.mistech.bone_lock.open: §5The door crumbles... and something huge stirs inside.
message.mistech.goblin_totem.solved: §bThe totems face the fire. Something opened.
message.mistech.goblin_queen.awake: §5The Goblin Queen rises from her throne!
message.mistech.goblin_queen.dead: §6The Goblin Queen has fallen. The seal behind the throne crumbles.
guide.mistech.goblin_village.1:
Wandering the §8Murky Wastes§r you may find a §2Goblin Village§r: huts behind a log palisade, full of §2Corrupted Goblins§r - small, fast and aggressive.

In the middle of the village a §8pit§r with a spiral staircase leads down to the catacombs.
guide.mistech.goblin_village.2:
The §8catacombs§r are a dark maze with §2goblins§r, §cAberrations§r (poisonous bite) and §7Trolls§r - strong, slow, and they regenerate unless they are on fire.

Watch the pressure plates: there are arrow traps.
guide.mistech.goblin_village.3:
The arena in the center is locked by a §fBone Lock§r. There are three §fBone Keys§r, each in a room on the edge of the maze:

§bTotems§r: turn them until all face the fire.
§dRune Stones§r: touching one flips it and its neighbors - light them all.
§7Corridor§r: traps and a Troll guard.
guide.mistech.goblin_village.4:
§5Goblin Queen§r: fat, slow and full of magic. Summons fangs from the ground, orbs that make you float, §dteleports everyone in the arena§r to random spots and calls goblins to defend her.

At half health she gets faster. When she falls, the treasure room behind the throne opens.
item.mistech.troll_club.tooltip: Heavy: knocks back and sometimes stuns
guide.mistech.luck_rune.1:
A §2complex rune§r: it is not written on the table, it is born on the §5Impure Altar§r from the Rune of Time.

• In the air: §2Luck II§r for 2 min.
• On a creature: it becomes §2luck-marked§r for 60 s — if it dies in that time, drops and XP are doubled.

Affinity goes to §3Time§r.
guide.mistech.arcane_rune.1:
Complex rune made on the altar from the Rune of Energy.

• In the air: discharges §d5,000 FE§r into the energy items in your inventory (hand, off hand, armor, the rest) — mithril gear, Gnome Staff...
• On a block that stores energy: inserts §d10,000 FE§r.

It is also the heart of §bmithril gear§r. Affinity goes to §eEnergy§r.
guide.mistech.magic_smoke.5:
§5Complex runes§r also work in the recipe:

§2Luck§r — Cigar: Luck, Hero of the Village, Regeneration. Joint: Luck II, §2Fortune§r (25% chance to double block and creature drops), Haste.

§dArcane Energy§r — Cigar: §dArcane Aegis§r (-50% magic damage), Absorption II. Joint: §dArcane Surge§r (staff spells cost half and mithril uses no energy), Strength, Speed.
guide.mistech.gnome_staff.5:
§2Luck§r (3,000 FE): aiming at a creature marks it with luck for 60 s and makes it glow — doubled drops and XP when it dies. With no target, you and anyone within 6 blocks get Luck II and Fortune.

§dArcane Energy§r (2,500 FE): §darcane bolt§r up to 32 blocks — 8 magic damage, chains to up to 3 nearby creatures (5 each) and strips their Absorption.
guide.mistech.runic_pipe.3:
Only the Runic Pipe draws an §5extra effect§r from complex runes:

§2Luck§r — the smoke spreads: players within 8 blocks get the same effects, and each puff has an 8% chance of finding an §aemerald§r.

§dArcane Energy§r — each puff charges §d2,000 FE§r into the energy items in your inventory.
guide.mistech.mithril_gear.recipe: Works on any netherite piece: helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots, sword, spear, pickaxe, axe, shovel and hoe.
guide.mistech.mithril_gear.1: Netherite gear bathed in §bmithril§r on a Tier I altar. It gets a bit stronger, keeps enchantments, name and trims, and §bnever breaks§r: instead of durability it spends §denergy§r.
guide.mistech.mithril_gear.2:
§dEnergy§r: 200,000 FE per piece, leaves the ritual with 25,000. Each point of wear costs 50 FE (Unbreaking still helps).

Charge it in the §5Runic Battery§r (or any charger), with the §dArcane Energy Rune§r or by smoking the Runic Pipe with it.

§cWithout energy§r: tools mine like a bare hand and weapons and armor lose all attributes.
guide.mistech.mithril_gear.3:
§bFull set§r (all 4 pieces charged):
• §b+20% speed§r;
• §b60% less magic damage§r (magic, harming potions, dragon breath, Wither, Warden roar, thorns).

Tools: netherite tier, speed 12, +6 damage. Armor: 4/8/6/4, toughness 4, knockback resistance 0.2.
guide.mistech.awakened_heart.1: The Impure Heart only wakes while the sky tears apart: §eonly during a thunderstorm§r (the Storm Call helps).
guide.mistech.mithril_obelisk.1: §bMithril Obelisk§r: 4 of them on the altar's (4,4) diagonals. They channel Tier II and III rituals.
guide.mistech.astral_heart.1: A second Impure Heart, crowned with the metals of the Gnome Depths and a §fNether Star§r. Only under the §8new moon§r, on a Tier II altar.
guide.mistech.orichalcum_brazier.1: §6Orichalcum Brazier§r: light it with flint and steel, a fire charge or a Fire Rune; put it out with a shovel or water — thunderstorms put it out too.
guide.mistech.altar_tier3.legend: Tier II + Astral Pillars (T) at 4 and Braziers (B) at 5, in the 4 directions.
guide.mistech.ritual_styles.1:
Every ritual has its own look: the threads leaving the pedestals, a §5ring that spins and closes§r on the altar as the ritual advances, a growing column and its own sound.

Shadow calls release souls; the storm drops §elightning§r; the harvest, spores; mithril, §bforge sparks§r; the ascensions make the §bobelisks§r take lightning at the end.
item.mistech.arcane_rune.nothing: Nothing in your inventory to charge
item.mistech.runic_pipe.lucky_find: The lucky smoke revealed an emerald!
item.mistech.mithril.empty: Out of energy! It won't work until charged.
item.mistech.mithril.hint: Uses energy instead of durability. Full set: speed and magic resistance.
ritual.mistech.condition.new_moon: Only on a new moon night
message.mistech.ritual.structure.brazier: The Orichalcum Brazier at %s %s %s must be lit
message.mistech.ritual.ascension_needs: The ascension needs the new circle ready: %s
tooltip.mistech.pocket_battery.on: On: charges items in your inventory
guide.mistech.pocket_battery.1:
The §5Advanced Battery§r condensed by §dRunes of Arcane Energy§r. A §lTier I§r ritual with no condition.

The energy stored in the battery §lcarries over§r to the pocket one.
guide.mistech.pocket_battery.2:
Stores §61,000,000 FE§r and charges in any charger (like the charging slot of Runic Batteries).

While on and in your inventory, it charges items that use energy: §lhands, armor, accessories§r and the rest of the inventory. Up to 1,000 FE/t per item, 5,000 FE/t total.

§8Sneak + right-click to toggle.§r
guide.mistech.goblin_village.club:
§6Troll Club§r: rare (4%, more with Looting), only when you kill the Troll. Drops already worn.

10 damage, very slow. Every hit knocks far back and has a 25% chance to §lstun§r (Slowness III + Weakness for 2 s). Repair with logs.
guide.mistech.goblin_village.remains:
§2Fey Remains§r: dropped by Corrupted Goblins (0-2) and the Queen (3-6). Eating them poisons you, like a spider eye.

In the §5Runic Crusher§r (or Miner) with an Earth Rune they become §dFairy Dust§r.
guide.mistech.runic_crusher.dusts:
§fIron§r, §6gold§r and §ccopper§r dusts smelt in a furnace or blast furnace into ingots.

Fey Remains become §dFairy Dust§r.
tooltip.mistech.sealed: Sealed at the Sanctuary: never wears out (fails while you are Corrupted)

guide.mistech.taint.1:
All impure magic has a price: §5Taint§r, a corruption of the soul ranging from §50 to 100§r.

It rises when you touch §5Impure Essence§r, finish rituals at the Impure Altar (1 per essence level), suffer a §5Backlash§r (+15), use §5Impure Tools§r, carry impure things (Impure Magic Block, Impure Heart, Residue) or walk on §5Tainted Soil§r.
guide.mistech.taint.2:
§eStages§r
§e0–19 Pure§r: pure magic works fully.
§d20–39 Stained§r: pure magic at 75%.
§540–59 Tainted§r: −2 hearts; the Incense Veil reaches half as far.
§560–79 Corrupted§r: −4 hearts; monsters come for you; pure magic fails.
§480+ Profane§r: −6 hearts, occasional Wither, and purity burns.
guide.mistech.taint.3:
§eHow to cleanse§r
§5Open-sky sunlight§r, §5Rue§r and a §5Salt Bath§r cleanse slowly, but §5only down to 20§r.

Beyond that you need pure magic: swim in §5Purified Essence§r, drink a bottle of it (−15) or perform the §5Soul Purification§r at the Sanctuary (resets to zero).
guide.mistech.dowsing_pendulum.1:
Pocket dowsing. Use it in the air to measure your Taint, on a block to sense tainted soil, or on another player to measure theirs.

While held, a bar above the hotbar shows your Taint, and the crystal changes color with your stage.
guide.mistech.rue.1:
A cleansing herb. Seeds drop from grass (2.5%) and grow on farmland; when ripe it gives 2 to 4 §5Rue Leaves§r.

§5Rue Incense§r works like the common one and also cleanses the Taint of anyone in its smoke (in an Incense Holder it also slowly cleans Tainted Soil). A §5Rue Cigar§r removes 3 Taint per puff.
guide.mistech.salt.1: Fill the §5Evaporation Tray§r with water bottles (1 portion each) or a bucket (3). Under open sunlight each portion slowly turns into §5Coarse Salt§r. Click with an empty hand to collect.
guide.mistech.salt.2: §5Salt Bath§r: use Coarse Salt on a cauldron full of water and step in. Each bath removes 10 Taint (down to 20), once per day, and uses one water level.
guide.mistech.distiller.1:
Refines magic: §51,000 mB of Impure Essence§r become §5250 mB of Purified Essence§r and 1 §5Tainted Residue§r, in 20 s, using 20 FE/t and 1 use of a §5Mithril Filter§r.

Put impure bottles/buckets in the input slot or click the Distiller with them. Take pure essence out with an empty bottle or bucket, or with pipes.
guide.mistech.distiller.2:
§cMind the Residue§r: if the output slots fill up, the Distiller §5vents§r and taints the ground around it. Residue left on the ground for 30 s also seeps into the soil.

§5Purified Essence§r makes you fall slowly, cleanses those who swim in it and, when drunk, removes 15 Taint and Wither. On a zombie villager it cures instantly.
guide.mistech.tainted_soil.1:
Ground contaminated by Residue, Backlash, stagnant impure essence or the Distiller. Plants on it wither, monsters spawn on it at light 7 or less and anyone walking on it is tainted.

It spreads to nearby dirt, but weakens with each step and stops after 3.

To clean it: Rue Incense in an Incense Holder, or the §5Soil Consecration§r at the Sanctuary.
guide.mistech.crystallizer.1: The pure sibling of the Magic Compressor. Fill the lens with a Purified Essence Bottle; under §5open-sky sunlight§r it crystallizes in 15 s into a §5Pure Magic Shard§r. At night it only works under a §5full moon§r, at half speed.
guide.mistech.pure_generator.1: Burns Purified Essence: §5100 FE/t§r, 1 mB per tick (one bottle yields 25,000 FE). A 4,000 mB tank that takes bottles, buckets and pipes; sends up to 400 FE/t to each neighbor.
guide.mistech.sanctuary.legend: F = Sanctuary Font, P = Ritual Pedestal, W = water source, O = Mithril Obelisk.
guide.mistech.sanctuary.1:
The altar of pure magic. The Font holds up to 8 levels of §5Purified Essence§r (bottle = 1, bucket = 3) and the catalyst; pedestals hold the ingredients. Use the §5Guide Stone§r on the Font to begin.

It needs §5open sky§r and §5nothing impure§r within 8 blocks (impure essence, Impure Magic Block, Tainted Soil, Impure Altar, Extractor…).
guide.mistech.sanctuary.2:
Whoever activates it must be §ePure§r (Taint below 20), except for the Soul Purification.

If the circle breaks midway, the ritual simply §5dissolves into light§r: there is no backlash and nothing is lost.
guide.mistech.sanctuary_rituals.purify: Resets the Taint of everyone next to the Font (and whoever activated it). Daytime only.
guide.mistech.sanctuary_rituals.consecra: Cleanses all Tainted Soil within 16 blocks.
guide.mistech.sanctuary_rituals.tools: Impure Pickaxe, Axe and Hoe become §ePure§r (enchantments kept): stronger, they never taint and they mend themselves in sunlight.
guide.mistech.sanctuary_rituals.seal: §eSealed Runes§r: any rune used as the catalyst comes out §5sealed§r: it never wears out, not even in machines. But a sealed rune §5fails§r in the hands of the Corrupted.

guide.mistech.celestial_events.1:
Some rituals change the §bwhole sky§r of the Overworld — for every player.

The §5impure§r side calls the night: §5Long Night§r, §cBlood Moon§r, §8Eclipse§r and §bStarfall§r.

The §eSanctuary§r calls the light: §eSolstice§r, §fSilver Moon§r, §aAurora§r and §eBlessed Rain§r. The Silver Moon is the only thing that can §fbanish§r a Blood Moon.
guide.mistech.celestial_events.2:
Each event has its own color in the sky and in the world's light. Long nights and days slow the clock down instead of skipping time.

§cLunar Blood§r drops from Blood Moon monsters. §bStar Fragments§r fall from meteors.

A Blood Moon may also come §con its own§r on a full moon night: 4% chance, up to 30% if someone is Profane.

guide.mistech.folklore.summon_curupira: By day, at the Sanctuary. The guardian of the woods, with §6fiery hair§r and backward feet. Fed with Dried Tobacco Leaf: monsters following you from afar §alose your trail§r, and it §aplants dropped saplings§r and makes planted ones grow.
guide.mistech.folklore.werewolf.1:
The §cWerewolf§r prowls around §evillages§r on full moon nights (rarely, one at a time) and appears anywhere during a Blood Moon. It is fast, leaps at its target and regenerates — unless struck with §fsilver§r (mithril weapons deal 2.5× damage and stop its regeneration).

At dawn the curse lifts and it turns back into an §aunemployed villager§r. Drops §cWerewolf Fangs§r.
guide.mistech.folklore.werewolf.2:
§cLycanthropy§r: the bite may pass on the curse. On full moon nights you transform: Strength II, Speed, Jump Boost and Night Vision — but with Hunger, rising Taint and a weakness to silver.

Only the Sanctuary's §eCure of Lycanthropy§r lifts the curse.
guide.mistech.folklore.silver_incense:

While it burns, no werewolf appears nearby — in your hand it protects you; in the §6Incense Holder§r, 48 blocks around it (great for guarding a village).
guide.mistech.folklore.cure_lycanthropy: By day, at the Sanctuary: removes Lycanthropy from whoever stands by the Font (and whoever started it). Silver means mithril.
guide.mistech.folklore.awaken_boitata:
Only during a Blood Moon, on a Tier III altar. Awakens the §6Boitatá§r, the fire serpent that guards the woods: 300 health, flies through everything, spits fire, lunges and burns whoever touches its body. Below half health it §crains fire§r.

Drops §6Scales§r and the §6Boitatá Eye§r.
guide.mistech.folklore.summon_headless_m: On a Friday night, on a Tier III altar. The §6Headless Mule§r is born tame and saddled: fireproof, §6walks on lava§r, fast and a high jumper. Its rider resists fire, and whatever it tramples catches fire. Like any mule, it takes a §6chest§r (right-click with one) and its saddle can be swapped; sneak + right-click opens its inventory.
guide.mistech.folklore.folklore.1:

Makes §l2 seals§r per ritual. Right-click breaks one and creates a 48-block §3zone of silence§r for 1 day around you.

Inside it nothing a player does vibrates — sensors, shriekers and the Warden notice nothing — and shrieker warnings do not build up. Stepping on a shrieker still makes it shriek.
guide.mistech.echoling.1:
Deep Dark familiar: a little sculk ball floating behind you. Right-click to sit/follow.

Fed with §3Sculk§r or §aBottle o' Enchanting§r (10 min each, up to 16):
• noisy creatures within 24 blocks get an outline for 3 s, only for you, even behind walls;
• warns you when a Shrieker is within 16 blocks.
guide.mistech.guardian.1:
A §lTier III§r altar built §3in the Deep Dark§r. A §3Warden§r rises 4 blocks from the altar, already furious at whoever did the ritual, and does not dig back down.

When it dies it drops the §3Sculk Heart§r and some Echo Shards.

Tip: building down there is loud — use a §3Seal of Silence§r first.
guide.mistech.pale_heart.1: A §lTier II§r altar in the §7Pale Garden§r, at night. The catalyst is a §6Creaking Heart§r torn from a pale tree.
guide.mistech.infernal_heart.1: A §lTier III§r altar built §cin the Nether§r, with the Wither's §eNether Star§r as the catalyst. The altar's essence does not evaporate: it stays in the basin.
guide.mistech.primordial_heart.1:
The catalyst is the §5Impure Heart§r; the other three hearts, the Awakened Heart and four runes go on the pedestals. Full moon, §lTier III§r altar, 60 s.

The §dPrimordial Heart§r is the key to the altar's next step — §ostill being built§r.
guide.mistech.magic_smoke.6: §3Echo§r — Cigar: §3Silent Step§r (you make no vibrations: sculk and the Warden notice nothing), Resistance. Joint: §3Echolocation§r (noisy creatures nearby get an outline only you see), Night Vision.
guide.mistech.gnome_staff.6: §3Echo§r (4,000 FE, 4 s cooldown): charged §3Warden shriek§r — 24 blocks, through walls and every creature in line, 14 armor-piercing damage.
guide.mistech.runic_pipe.4: §3Echo§r — each puff sends a §3sonar pulse§r: creatures within 24 blocks get an outline for 5 s (only you see it).
rune_socket.mistech.vigil: Hostiles you look at are slowed (level = runes, up to III)
rune_socket.mistech.soul: Hits inflict Wither 1 s per rune; 2 or more: Soul Veil
tooltip.mistech.amber_sealed: Sealed in resin: never wears out, but recharges after use

guide.mistech.vigil_rune.1:
A §7Pale Garden§r rune (Darkness + Earth).

• Right-click: for 8 s, every creature you §llook at§r is §7Watched§r — frozen in place, unable to walk, fly or deal damage. Not bosses.

§7Cigar§r: Vigilant Ward (whoever targets you is slowed) + Night Vision.
§7Joint§r: Heavy Gaze (whoever you look at is slowed and weakened) + Strength.
guide.mistech.vigil_rune.2:
§7Staff§r (2,500 FE): freezes everything in a 12-block cone for 4 s.
§7Socketed§r: hostiles you look at are slowed (level = runes, up to III).

Affinity: §5Darkness§r + §6Earth§r.
guide.mistech.soul_rune.1:
A §bNether§r rune (Fire + Darkness).

• Right-click: 60 s of §bSoul Veil§r — piglins, hoglins, blazes, ghasts, magma cubes and wither skeletons do not target you (unless you attack). Aimed at a block, it also lights a fire (soul fire on soul sand/soil).
guide.mistech.soul_rune.2:
§bCigar§r: Fire Resistance + Soul Veil.
§bJoint§r: Soul Touch (hits inflict Wither II) + Speed.
§bStaff§r (3,000 FE): 8-block cone of blue flames — 4 damage, fire and Wither II.
§bSocketed§r: hits inflict Wither 1 s per rune; 2 or more = Soul Veil.

Affinity: §cFire§r + §5Darkness§r.
guide.mistech.amber_seal.1:
At the §5Writing Table§r, place §lany rune + 1 Resin Clump§r (10 chalk, 1 paper). The rune comes out §6sealed in amber§r: it §lnever wears out§r, but after each use it recharges — 30 s for basic runes, 60 s for advanced and complex ones.

In machines and smoking it wears out normally. A rune already sealed at the Sanctuary cannot be sealed.
guide.mistech.eyeblossom_incense.1:
Works like regular incense (Incense Veil) and also makes §6nearby hostiles glow§r: 10 blocks around whoever carries it lit, or the whole Incense Holder area.

The Eyeblossom only opens at night, in the Pale Garden.
guide.mistech.pale_chalk.1: Does everything Ash Chalk does (runes and Chalk Marks), with §l300 uses§r.
guide.mistech.pale_sentinel.1:
Use the §7Creaking Heart§r on a §7Pale Oak Log§r: it is consumed and awakens a §7Sentinel§r bound to that log (up to 2 per player).

It guards 16 blocks around, attacks §lhostiles§r and never players — but, like the Creaking, §lit freezes while someone looks at it§r. Break the log and it falls apart.
guide.mistech.igneous_essence.1:
In the Nether §5Impure Essence§r boils away: the altar refuses its bottles and buckets. But an §5Extractor§r running in the Nether fills with essence that comes out as bottles of §6Igneous Essence§r (buckets do not work there).

The altar accepts Igneous Essence anywhere and, in the Nether, gives Igneous back when you fill a bottle from it.
guide.mistech.igneous_essence.2: §5Crying Shard§r: fill the §5Magic Compressor§r with Igneous Essence (with incense nearby, as usual) and it hardens into a Crying Shard instead of an Impure Magic Shard.
guide.mistech.piglin_pact.1:
Altar in the §cNether§r. For §l3 days§r piglins and brutes stay neutral to you and anyone within 8 blocks of the altar, even without gold (unless you attack).

And every barter from a piglin near someone with the pact has a §l50%§r chance to come out doubled.
guide.mistech.runic_strider.1: Nether familiar. Comes saddled, is §l40% faster§r and is steered §lwithout the fungus stick§r (forward/back). Follows you when no one is riding and, if you fall into lava within 16 blocks, rushes over and puts you on its back. Warped Fungus heals it.
guide.mistech.infernal_tools.1:
§lTier II§r altar. The impure tool goes in the center (keeps its enchantments). Fire resistant, 2,500 uses, netherite tier.

§cPickaxe§r: auto-smelt + 30% chance to double ores.
§cAxe§r: up to 128 logs (Nether stems too).
§cHoe§r: 5×5.
§cDagger§r: Wither II and 40% Magic Residue.
guide.mistech.blaze_generator.1:
Burns §6Blaze Rods§r (24,000 FE) or §6Blaze Powder§r (10,000 FE) at §l40 FE/t§r.
×1.5 with lava touching it and ×1.5 in the Nether (both: 90 FE/t).

Stores 40,000 FE and sends up to 400 FE/t to adjacent blocks.
guide.mistech.portal_anchor.1: Place it in the §lOverworld§r and click to bind yourself. From then on, §levery portal that brings you back from the Nether drops you at the anchor§r. Sneak-click to unbind; if the anchor is broken, the binding is gone.
guide.mistech.magic_smoke.7:
§7Vigil§r — Cigar: Vigilant Ward (whoever targets you is slowed), Night Vision. Joint: Heavy Gaze (whoever you look at is slowed and weakened), Strength.

§bSoul§r — Cigar: Fire Resistance, Soul Veil. Joint: Soul Touch (Wither II on hit), Speed.
guide.mistech.gnome_staff.7:
§7Vigil§r (2,500 FE): freezes everything in a 12-block cone for 4 s.

§bSoul§r (3,000 FE): 8-block cone of blue flames — 4 damage, 4 s of fire and Wither II.
item.mistech.lily_incense.lit: Lit Lily of the Valley Incense
screen.mistech.astrology.xp_collector: %s levels — the Echo Collector pays (%s pts)
guide.mistech.echo_collector.3: §3Astrology Table§r: if you lack the levels for a star, Echo Collectors within §l8 blocks of the table§r pay for you — each level costs its points counted from zero (10 levels = 160 points). The screen shows when the collector will pay.
guide.mistech.runic_note_block.1:
§3Wireless§r redstone through sculk. Right-click picks the §lfrequency§r (1 to 15; sneak to go down).

On a redstone pulse it plays: every §3Calibrated Sculk Sensor§r within §l64 blocks§r whose back input has the §lsame strength§r activates at once and gives off its signal.
guide.mistech.runic_note_block.2: Tip: put a redstone block or a comparator behind the sensor to set the strength (frequency). Sensors with 0 on the back input do not answer the runic block.
guide.mistech.flower_incenses.1:
Two sticks and §ltwo§r of the flower. They work like regular incense and also, in the smoke (10 blocks around whoever carries it, or the Incense Holder area):

§8Wither Rose§r: hostiles get Wither.
§6Torchflower§r: players get Night Vision.
§fLily of the Valley§r: players get Regeneration I.
guide.mistech.writing_table.pale: §7Pale Oak§r: made with §lpale oak slabs§r, the table comes out with a light top and legs (any cloth color). It stays pale when broken.
guide.mistech.ritual_pedestal.pale: §7Pale Oak Pedestal§r: the same recipe with a §lPale Oak Log§r instead of the Murky Log. Works the same in the circle.

guide.mistech.metal_blocks.1: Nine ingots make a §lblock§r (and a block turns back into nine ingots). Mithril, Adamantine and Orichalcum blocks also work as a §lbeacon base§r, and their ingots can pay the beacon.
guide.mistech.metal_blocks.2: §lFlint§r + a §lraw ore block§r of the metal makes a lighter. It works just like Flint and Steel, but lasts much longer: Mithril 256 uses, Adamantine 640, Orichalcum 1280.
guide.mistech.spatial_anchor.1: A pillar that folds space. Tier I ritual.
guide.mistech.spatial_anchor.2:
Place the anchor (2 blocks tall). Rename the item on an anvil first to give it a name.

§lRight-click§r an anchor to §lattune§r to it: it joins your list. The list opens on every anchor you touch; pick one and you travel there.
guide.mistech.spatial_anchor.3:
The trip costs §lexperience levels§r: 1 level for every 1000 blocks (up to 5), and §l5 levels§r to another dimension. Short trips are free.

If an anchor is broken it disappears from everyone's list.
guide.mistech.translocation_orb.1: A pocket anchor. Right-click to open your anchor list from anywhere. Costs the same levels as an anchor, spends 1 of its 48 uses and needs 15 s to recharge.
guide.mistech.natal_realign.1:
With an altar of §lTier II§r you can choose the sign of your §5Sun§r, §5Moon§r or §5Ascendant§r, one at a time. The chosen part is revealed at once.

Catalyst: your §lNatal Chart§r.
guide.mistech.natal_realign.2: To choose the sign, put the §lrare item§r of its constellation on a pedestal (the same one used at the Astrology Table): Aries blaze powder, Taurus golden apple, Gemini rabbit foot, Cancer nautilus shell, Leo blaze rod, Virgo emerald, Libra iron block, Scorpio fermented spider eye, Sagittarius ender pearl, Capricorn diamond, Aquarius glow ink sac, Pisces tropical fish.

guide.mistech.cat.d_overworld_tier3.desc: The last altar and the great spirits.

guide.mistech.cat.d_pale.desc: The watchful trees and the Creaking.

guide.mistech.spatial_anchor.4:
To §lrename§r an anchor, open it and type the new name at the bottom of the list (Enter or "Rename").

§lShift + right-click§r with a §ldye§r paints the rune and the crystal of the pillar.
rune_socket.mistech.cloud: -15%% fall damage per rune; 3 or more: no fall damage and Slow Falling while sneaking midair
guide.mistech.cloud_rune.1:
A §bsky§r rune (Air + Vapor), made on a §lTier II§r altar — and only §bwhile it rains§r.

• Right-click: creates a §fcloud§r where you aim (up to 5 blocks). While falling and looking down, it appears §lunder your feet§r.
• The cloud is §lsemi-solid§r: firm from above, but you can jump through it from below, and §7sneaking§r drops you through. Absorbs 80% of fall damage.
• Fades after §b30 s§r.
guide.mistech.cloud_rune.stable.title: Stable Cloud
guide.mistech.cloud_rune.stable: Use the rune on §fwhite wool§r: up to 8 touching wool blocks turn into §fStable Cloud§r — the same cloud, but §lpermanent§r. Great for building in the sky.
guide.mistech.cloud_rune.2:
§7Cigar§r: Slow Falling + Jump Boost.
§7Joint§r: Speed + Jump Boost III + Slow Falling.
§7Staff§r (2,000 FE): a 3 × 12 cloud bridge ahead of you.
§7Runic Pipe§r: puffing while falling makes a 3×3 cloud platform under you.
§7Socketed§r: -15% fall damage per rune; with 3 or more, no fall damage and Slow Falling while sneaking midair.

Affinity: §fAir§r + §cFire§r + §9Water§r.

guide.mistech.runic_artifacts.1:
An §dartifact§r is a piece bound to a rune: its power is always on, no socket needed.

Like coated gear, artifacts use §benergy§r instead of durability — charge them with the §5Pocket Battery§r or batteries.
guide.mistech.runic_artifacts.2:
The base varies:

§bMithril§r — simple and strong, no sockets.
§cAdamantine§r — 3 sockets on the Rune Anvil.
§6Orichalcum§r — 6 sockets.

Some socketed runes change the artifact power. Artifact accessories go in the §lJ§r slots.
guide.mistech.wind_boots.1:
§bMithril§r. Press §ljump§r again in midair for a §bdouble jump§r (200 FE). Each jump resets your fall.

The boots count as mithril for the full-set bonus.
guide.mistech.wind_boots.2: With two §fCloud Runes§r the boots gain §fCloud Step§r: §ltriple jump§r, and each extra jump leaves a cloud under your feet.
guide.mistech.frost_skates.1:
§bMithril§r. Walking §bfreezes§r still water within 3 blocks. On §bice§r you are §l60% faster§r.

Uses 10 FE per second while walking.
guide.mistech.storm_gauntlet.1:
§bMithril§r. A punching weapon. Each hit (once per second) releases §echain lightning§r that jumps to up to §l3§r creatures within 6 blocks, 5 damage each (400 FE).

It never hits players or your pets.
guide.mistech.volcanic_hammer.1:
§cAdamantine§r (3 sockets). Mines §l3×3§r (sneaking: 1×1) and §6smelts§r what drops (ore into ingots, sand into glass), with the furnace experience.

§7Sneak + right-click§r toggles smelting.
§7Socketed Earth Rune§r: §l5×5§r area.
guide.mistech.tide_mask.1:
§cAdamantine§r (3 sockets). With your head underwater: §3Conduit Power§r (endless breath, clear sight, normal mining). 20 FE/s while submerged.

§7Socketed Water Rune§r: Dolphin's Grace.
guide.mistech.beacon_crown.1:
§cAdamantine§r (3 sockets). §eNight Vision§r always, and monsters within 24 blocks that you can §lsee§r glow. 20 FE/s.

§7Socketed Echo Rune§r: they glow even behind walls.
guide.mistech.cloud_broom.1:
§6Orichalcum§r (6 sockets). §lRight-click§r releases the broom and you mount it.

• Forward/back: fly where you look.
• Jump: rise.
• Sneak: get off (and fall slowly).

Uses 200 FE per second while mounted; out of energy, it glides down.
guide.mistech.cloud_broom.2:
Left alone, it floats in place. §7Right-click§r to mount again; §7sneak + right-click§r (or hit it) to pick it up.

Socketed runes: §fAir§r = faster, §eEnergy§r = cheaper, §fCloud§r = cloud trail and longer slow fall, §eLight§r = glows, §cFire§r/§bIce§r = trail.
guide.mistech.shadow_cloak.1:
§6Orichalcum§r (6 sockets). Night ritual. §7Sneaking still§r for 1 s: you turn §8invisible§r and chasing monsters lose their target. 10 FE/s.

§7Socketed Void Rune§r: 15% per rune (up to 45%) to §5vanish and reappear§r nearby when hurt (5 s cooldown).
guide.mistech.tide_spear.1:
§6Orichalcum§r (6 sockets). Rain ritual, on a trident (enchantments carry over). Built-in §lLoyalty III§r: it always returns.

§7Sneaking§r, releasing = §3riptide§r in water, rain or standing on a §fcloud§r — no enchantment needed (400 FE).
guide.mistech.void_magnet.1:
Amulet (§lJ§r key). Pulls dropped items within 8 blocks (2 FE per item). Not while sneaking.

§7Right-click§r in hand: on/off.
§7Sneak + right-click§r with an item in the other hand: add/remove it from the §5void list§r (up to 9) — the magnet deletes it instead of pulling.
guide.mistech.pocket_hourglass.1:
Amulet (§lJ§r key). Plants within 5 blocks grow faster and §lfurnaces§r there work twice as fast. 20 FE/s.

§7Right-click§r in hand: on/off.
guide.mistech.spatial_ring.1:
Ring (§lJ§r key). Press §lV§r to open the list of §5Spatial Anchors§r you know and travel from anywhere.

Instead of levels, it pays §benergy§r: 5,000 FE (10,000 to another dimension).
item.mistech.arcane_tuner.desc: Links Pylons; copies a Nexus tuning and pastes it on Ethereal Nodes/Receivers
message.mistech.tuner.no_network: Copy the tuning from an Ethereal Nexus first
message.mistech.tuner.pylon_first: Pylon chosen; now click another pylon
message.mistech.tuner.pylon_full: One of the pylons already has %s links
message.mistech.ether.nexus_flow: In: %s FE/t · Out: %s FE/t · Nodes: %s · Receivers: %s
guide.mistech.transmission_pylon.tuner: The §5Arcane Tuner§r links network parts. §7Sneak + right-click§r in the air clears what it holds.
guide.mistech.transmission_pylon.1:
Carries energy far, with no loss. With the Tuner, click a pylon and then another up to §l48 blocks§r away to link them (up to 4 links; clicking again unlinks). A purple beam appears between them.

§fRight-click§r (empty hand) cycles the mode — the crystal changes color:
§5Relay§r (purple): only passes along.
§aInput§r (green): pulls energy from the block §lbelow§r it (generator, battery).
§6Output§r (gold): delivers to the block §lbelow§r it (machine, battery).

Up to 10,000 FE/t per output. Sneak + right-click only shows the mesh status. Arcane Nodes/Receivers near pylons still work too.
guide.mistech.ethereal_network.1:
The §dEthereal Nexus§r stores the energy of a §dtuning§r. Each §5Advanced Runic Battery§r touching it (the 8 around, same height) becomes a §lcell§r: 500k FE + 1 million per cell.

The energy lives in the tuning, not the block: it works with the Nexus far away. Right-click shows the network. Broken, the item keeps the tuning.
guide.mistech.ethereal_network.2:
The §5Ethereal Node§r pulls from the block it is attached to (up to 50,000 FE/t) and the §5Ethereal Receiver§r delivers (up to 20,000 FE/t) — at §lany distance and in any dimension§r, lossless.

With the Tuner: click the Nexus to copy its tuning, then the Nodes and Receivers.
item.mistech.archive_scroll.desc: Goes in the Archive Core. Contents stay in the scroll even outside the Core.
item.mistech.archive_mirror.desc: Right-click in the air: open the Archive from afar
screen.mistech.archive.clear: Return the grid to the Archive
message.mistech.archive.no_core: No Archive Core reaches this table (16 blocks, or use Relays)
message.mistech.archive_port.export: Mode: push from the Archive (filter only)
message.mistech.archive_mirror.unbound: Bind the mirror to a Core first
message.mistech.archive_mirror.gone: The bound Core no longer exists
guide.mistech.archive_core.1:
The heart of the §5Spatial Archive§r, a central storage §lwithout cables§r. Holds up to 9 §dSpatial Scrolls§r and needs §benergy§r (1 FE/t + each scroll cost; 5,000 FE/t input).

Right-click opens the scroll slots.
guide.mistech.archive_core.2:
Scrolls (types / items / FE per tick):
§7Common§r 27 / 4,096 / 2
§bMithril§r 63 / 32,768 / 5
§cAdamantine§r 63 / 262,144 / 10
§6Orichalcum§r 127 / 2,097,152 / 20
§5Void§r 1 type, unlimited / 5

Contents live in the scroll: you can take it out and move it to another Core.
guide.mistech.archive_terminal.1:
Shows §leverything§r stored. Must be within 16 blocks of the Core (or a Relay).

• Click: take a stack (right: half).
• Shift + click: straight to your inventory.
• Click with an item held: store it (right: just 1).
• Shift + click in your inventory: store the stack.
guide.mistech.archive_terminal.2:
§lSearch§r: name, §7@mod§r or §7#tag§r. The button next to it changes the order (name, count, mod).

The §l3×3 crafting grid§r pulls from the Archive: after each craft, used-up ingredients come back by themselves. Shift on the result crafts as many as possible. The §7×§r returns the grid to the Archive.
guide.mistech.archive_network.relay: The §5Relay§r extends the Core reach by 16 more blocks from it. Relays chain: each one within 16 of another (or of the Core) joins.
guide.mistech.archive_network.seal: The §5Seal§r, attached to a container (Spatial Barrel, chest, the Miner Chamber...), adds its contents to the Archive: they show on the Table and receive what does not fit in the scrolls.
guide.mistech.archive_network.port: The §5Port§r, attached to a container or machine, moves 64 items every half second. §7Empty hand§r toggles the mode: §lpull§r (container into Archive) or §lpush§r (Archive into container, filter only). §7Right-click with an item§r: add/remove it from the filter (up to 9). §7Sneak with empty hand§r: clear.
guide.mistech.archive_mirror.1:

guide.mistech.the_magician.1:

guide.mistech.the_magician.2:
§6Phases§r

§eII§r (75%) Alchemy: two at once (Magma, Vapor, Storm, Life, Sand, Living Flame).
§eIII§r (50%) The Four Aspects, as a team.

guide.mistech.cuca.1: §5Boss§r (400 health). The alligator witch comes for anyone who goes §l3 nights without sleeping§r and wanders the Ancestral Forest at night, or through the ritual (Tier 3 altar, at night, cauldron as catalyst, with 2 Matinta Feathers). She also lives in the §lCuca's Den§r, a crooked hut in the Ancestral Forest with skull totems and a smoking chimney: walk up to it and she comes out the door.
guide.mistech.cuca.2: She throws potions, brews poison clouds, sings the lullaby (blindness and slowness) and teleports when hurt. Below half health she calls her witch apprentices. Poison does nothing to her.
guide.mistech.cuca.3: She drops the §5Cuca's Cauldron§r: with fire underneath, put in up to 3 potions to mix their effects into one (an Impure Essence raises every level by +1). Take it out with a glass bottle; sneak with an empty hand to empty it.

It appears rarely at night in the Ancestral Forest, or through the ritual (Tier 3 altar, at night). Arrows and projectiles barely hurt it (25%); it knocks down leaves as it walks. Its home is the §lMapinguari Cave§r: a hole surrounded by bones and clawed stumps in the Ancestral Forest leads down to a huge chamber with its nest.
guide.mistech.mapinguari.2: It slams the ground (damage and knockback) and its stinking roar causes nausea, weakness and hunger. Its §2Claws§r make the §2Mapinguari Axe§r (3 claws + 2 sticks): it fells the whole tree at once, even the Ancestral Trees.
