§fUse on a golem§r: gives it the route. §fSneak on a golem§r: copies its route.
guide.mistech.runic_golem_wand.2:
§fUse in the air§r to change the §6deliver§r mode; §fsneak in the air§r for the §acollect§r mode.

§aCollect§r — §fPriority§r: the first origin that has something. §fRound-robin§r: one at a time. §fFullest§r: the one with the most.

§6Deliver§r — §fPriority§r: the first destination with room. §fRound-robin§r: one at a time. §fEven§r: the one with the least of it, keeping them level.

Works for Terracotta, Mithril and Blackstone golems (items and fluids).
message.mistech.gnome_realm.edge: The dream fades to white... you wake up.
message.mistech.gnome_realm.startle: You fell... and woke with a start at the edge.
guide.mistech.gnome_realm.4:
• §bDeep Dream§r (up to ~5000): the §dpsychedelic§r side — hills below and §ffloating islands§r high above. §bBouncy Clouds§r on the ground launch you up to the islands (with Slow Falling). Sub-biomes: §bFloating Meadows§r (low gravity), §dFractal Garden§r (Fractal Trees) and §aInverted Forest§r.
• §9REM Sleep§r (past 5000): §8mysterious and dark§r — §9Starry Void§r, §6Memory Quilt§r and the rare §4Abyssal Gaze§r.
guide.mistech.gnome_realm.5:
Around §f30,000 blocks§r lies the §fEdge of the Dream§r: everything turns to white fog and, if you cross it, you wake up.

In the Nightmare, beware: the §4Eye Flower§r gives you away to monsters, §8Black Thorn§r snags and hurts, and falling into a Chasm wakes you with a start at the edge.
message.mistech.wrong_house.loop: This room... haven't you been here before?
message.mistech.wrong_house.loop.last: The house tires of the game and lets you through.
message.mistech.endless_stair.loop: The same steps. The same window. Again.
message.mistech.endless_stair.loop.last: This time the stairs seem to end.
guide.mistech.gnome_realm.6: §fCounting Sheep§r graze in the §2Common Dream§r. Shear them for §fCloud Wool§r. With an empty hand you §ecount§r a sheep — count §e3 different sheep§r within 30 seconds and you feel §arested§r (Regeneration and Saturation).
guide.mistech.gnome_realm.7:
§6Gnome Hamlets§r are scattered across the Common Dream: mushroom cottages around a campfire, with chests, a sheep pen and a §3Gnome Merchant§r (blue hat) who trades dream goods for emeralds.

In the Nightmare there are §8Ruined Hamlets§r, overrun by §cCorrupted Gnomes§r.
guide.mistech.gnome_realm.8: The §8Bogeyman§r lives in the Nightmare's dark. In the shadows it blinds you, drags you and vanishes behind you. §eBright light§r makes it slow, weak and burning — bring torches!
guide.mistech.gnome_realm.9:
The §8Shade§r only moves when nobody is looking. §eLook at it§r and it freezes; turn your back and it closes in. Everything slows down near it.

§cCorrupted Gnomes§r hunt players and gnomes, and their hits weaken you.
guide.mistech.gnome_realm.10:
Strange places in the Nightmare:
• §8Wrong House§r (Wrong Neighborhood): three identical rooms... or the same room three times? At the back, a bedroom — don't go near the beds.
• §8Endless Stair§r: a tower whose stairs repeat the same laps. Keep going and reach the chest at the top.
message.mistech.gnome_miner.found: The miner sniffs the air: "%s! About %s blocks %s."
message.mistech.gnome_miner.none: The miner scratches his beard: "Nothing worth digging around here."
message.mistech.gnome_miner.tired: The miner is still getting his nose back.
guide.mistech.gnome_realm.11: §6Gnome Miners§r work in the King's mine and in the Depths, with a lamp helmet and a pickaxe. Click one with an §eempty hand§r and he sniffs out the §bnearest ore§r (20 blocks): what it is, how far and which way. He needs 30 s to get his nose back.
tooltip.mistech.lucid_dreamcatcher.help: Sneak + use: pick the layer. Only takes you to layers you have visited.
message.mistech.lucid_dreamcatcher.not_d: It only works inside a dream.
message.mistech.lucid_dreamcatcher.unkno: You haven't dreamed of that layer yet.
message.mistech.lucid_dreamcatcher.lost: The dream slips away... try again.
message.mistech.cloud_whale.full: The whale sings, content. (The amber has not formed yet.)
message.mistech.echo.caught: Your own footsteps caught up with you.
message.mistech.rem_watcher.alarm: The chandelier of eyes has found you.
message.mistech.awakening_bell.wrong_pla: The bell does not ring here. Only in REM Sleep.
message.mistech.the_dreamer.summoned: The bell echoes through sleep. Something huge stirs... The Dreamer comes to see who called.
message.mistech.the_dreamer.awake: The mask splits open. THE DREAMER IS AWAKE.
message.mistech.the_dreamer.defeated: The Dreamer falls back asleep — and the dream becomes a little more yours.
message.mistech.memory.0: "...the smell of cake coming out of grandma's oven, on a rainy Sunday."
message.mistech.memory.1: "...the first time I saw the sea. I thought it never ended."
message.mistech.memory.2: "...someone calling my name from far away. I never knew who."
message.mistech.memory.3: "...a house with one more hallway than it should have."
message.mistech.memory.4: "...rain on the tin roof, and me wide awake."
message.mistech.memory.5: "...a song I know by heart, but never heard while awake."
message.mistech.memory.6: "...a yellow dog that followed me to school."
message.mistech.memory.7: "...the old house's stairs had one step that creaked. The seventh."
message.mistech.memory.8: "...I was falling, falling... and woke up before the ground."
message.mistech.memory.9: "...a door at the back of the yard that wasn't there yesterday."
message.mistech.memory.10: "...the face of someone I loved. It is already fading."
message.mistech.memory.11: "...a whale passed over the city and nobody looked up."
message.mistech.memory.12: "...the living-room clock stopped at 3:17. All the clocks stopped."
message.mistech.memory.13: "...I knew I was dreaming. I was scared anyway."
book.mistech.memory_1.title: Dreamer's Diary, I
book.mistech.memory_1.page1:
Day 1.

I fell asleep and woke up here again. The whales drift slowly overhead, as if the sky were water.
book.mistech.memory_1.page2:
Day 9.

The islands move when nobody looks. I tied a red ribbon to one. Today the ribbon was on my pillow.
book.mistech.memory_1.page3:
Day 40.

I no longer remember which side is outside. If anyone finds this diary: don't ring the bell.
book.mistech.memory_2.title: Library Catalogue
book.mistech.memory_2.page1:
Section A: childhood memories.
Section B: memories that never happened.
Section C: (torn out)
book.mistech.memory_2.page2: The books in this house are written by sleepers. Each night, a page. Each waking, a page erased.
book.mistech.memory_2.page3: Warning: the floors don't sit on top of each other. They sit on top of what you remember.
book.mistech.memory_3.title: On Echoes
book.mistech.memory_3.page1:
The Echo doesn't chase you. It just walks the path you walked.

If you stop, it arrives.
book.mistech.memory_3.page2: Keep walking. Always. Don't go back the same way — it's coming that way.
book.mistech.memory_3.page3: The chandelier of eyes calls the Echoes. Don't let it see you for long.
book.mistech.memory_4.title: Lullaby
book.mistech.memory_4.page1:
Sleep, sleep, the mask
won't open its eyes yet.
If it does, it's not a dream —
it's you who never wakes.
book.mistech.memory_4.page2: To wake The Dreamer: memories, a watching eye, whale amber and moth dust, in a bell.
guide.mistech.gnome_realm.12:
In the §bDeep Dream§r live the §bCloud Whales§r, giants that swim high above the islands. With an §eempty hand§r you climb on its back and it roughly goes where you §elook§r. Feed it §fCloud Cotton§r and it sings — and sometimes drops §6Dream Amber§r.

With a §eSaddle§r it becomes a real mount: whoever sits in the saddle §esteers§r — move forward and it flies where you look (climbing and diving too), §ejump§r climbs. While steered it doesn't pass through blocks and can go to any layer. Sneak with an empty hand to take the saddle off.
guide.mistech.gnome_realm.13:
Schools of §dSky Fish§r swim through the air (eating one gives Slow Falling). The §dStained-Glass Moth§r has glowing stained-glass wings and is drawn to §elight§r: near lanterns it now and then sheds §dDream Dust§r.

The §5Fractal Temple§r is a giant Menger cube: climb the ramp and walk the tunnel to the hollow middle.
guide.mistech.gnome_realm.14:
In §8REM Sleep§r, the §8Echo§r walks §eexactly the path you walked§r, a few seconds later. If you stop, it catches you. One hit shatters it.

The §8REM Watcher§r is a chandelier of eyes: if it sees you for 2 seconds it raises the alarm, calling monsters and an Echo.
guide.mistech.gnome_realm.15:
§7Memories§r are figures in sepia dresses with a birdcage for a head. Click one: it tells a memory and leaves a §7Memory Shard§r.

The §8Library of Memories§r is a crooked tower: climb the scaffolding to the chest on the top floor.
guide.mistech.gnome_realm.16:
The §5Lucid Dreamcatcher§r travels between layers you have visited (sneak + use picks; use travels).

The §6Awakening Bell§r, rung in REM Sleep, calls §5The Dreamer§r: a porcelain mask with giant hands. At half health it §cwakes up§r. Drops §5Dreamer's Essence§r.
tooltip.mistech.spatial_dreamcatcher.hel: In the Dream: use on a creature to store it. Use on a block to release — in the Dream or in reality (sneak releases all).
message.mistech.spatial_dreamcatcher.onl: It only catches creatures from inside a dream.
message.mistech.spatial_dreamcatcher.too: That dream is too big for the web.
guide.mistech.gnome_realm.17:
The §5Spatial Dreamcatcher§r carries Dream creatures from place to place — even into reality. Inside the Dream, use it on a creature and it gets caught in the web (up to §e3§r; bosses don't fit). Use it on a block to release the last one — §esneak§r releases all — whether in another Dream layer or after you wake up. Each release wears the dreamcatcher a little.

A §bCloud Whale§r released this way keeps swimming around where it was set free, high above the ground, instead of going back to the Deep Dream.
